surprising_findings.case: Header Dominance vs. Granular Answer Chunks (TC-05)
surprising_findings.observation: When querying for specific operational parameters ('48-hour staging VPC confinement'), the top-level document runbook header ('acme_onboarding#tok_000') ranked #1 (+0.9979) ahead of the exact answer chunk ('acme_onboarding#tok_002', +0.7400). This occurs because the introductory chunk contains broad runbook metadata and high lexical density, overshadowing short tail chunks in dense semantic projection.
surprising_findings.architectural_insight: Retrieval must return Top-K (K>=3) chunks rather than Top-1, and parent-document retrieval or hierarchical chunk linking should be employed to preserve surrounding context.

surprising_findings.case: The Nearest-Neighbor Fallback Trap on Out-of-Domain Queries (TC-06)
surprising_findings.observation: For a totally unsupported query ('travel lunch expense reimbursement'), dense vector search still mathematically yields a 'top' nearest-neighbor ('acme_onboarding#tok_001', score +0.1520). Without an explicit minimum confidence threshold, a naive RAG retriever would treat this irrelevant chunk as supporting evidence, causing hallucinated answers.
surprising_findings.architectural_insight: ClientVault must enforce an explicit confidence threshold (e.g. cosine score >= 0.60). Queries falling below this threshold must deterministically trigger the PRD-mandated insufficient-evidence fallback rather than returning weak nearest neighbors.

surprising_findings.observation: A query regarding database outage escalation matches Vertex Health's disaster recovery runbook (+0.9653) and Nexus Financial's SLA (+0.6068). In an unfiltered global search, a support agent assisting Nexus could inadvertently receive Vertex procedures.
surprising_findings.architectural_insight: Confirms PRD Section 18.1 requirement: Metadata filtering on client_id must always precede similarity ranking to guarantee 100% account isolation before evidence reaches generation.

recommendations: Enforce a strict retrieval similarity threshold (cos >= 0.60) to reject out-of-domain queries.
Use Top-K >= 3 candidate window to ensure granular sub-procedure chunks are not eclipsed by document headers.
Always apply client_id isolation filter prior to vector similarity scoring.
Retain document provenance metadata so users can audit source runbook, section, and page.
